**Why promote rather than hold**: this is the third round of the same two ROADMAP sections drifting, and the previous two (#3700/PR #3705, #3704/PR #3714) plus the sibling batch (#3712/PR #3732) were all implemented — the method is established (rewrite in place, keep `[x]`, keep wrong names as correction anchors, plant no new counts) and the cost of holding is that line anchors rot under a file that merges daily. The `- [x] listMode …` and `metadataTypeRegistry.ts` rows actively send readers hunting for configuration and files that do not exist.

**Dispatch note**: :1001 must be handled per-entry (hub cards no longer point at the URL; sidebar/QuickActions do but that defect is carded separately per the body) — not a blanket rewrite.
